note: L: lip-sync on the approved V takes with LatentSync 1.6 (scripts/l_batch.py), which re-generates only the lower face from the vocal stem. It runs on a 512 px crop that follows the singer's face (YuNet boxes from scripts/l_faces.py) and is pasted back onto the V take through a feathered ellipse. LTX-2.3's audio-video model was tried first and dropped (2026-10-20): regenerating only the face kept a fixed mouth; re-denoising the whole frame synced on some seeds only, and moved the head off the V take's body (production log).
